limitations: Authored practice scenarios, not real supplier traffic or an unseen accuracy benchmark.
Future dates, email addresses and messages are authored. Supplier/product/quantity facts reference local dataset records.
Historical actual-delivery dates are excluded from application baselines and expected model inputs.
The existing synthetic holdout and realistic final split are unchanged.
Offline mode supplies expected model outputs: it checks orchestration, not whether a real model understands the messages.

sources.language: realistic tuning and synthetic development patterns; never reused as an unseen final score
